description: MOVES cards from one cluster to another: they stop being on the source and are laid out on the destination so they do not overlap what is there. Use it to move cards between clusters; to arrange cards inside one cluster use arrange_board.

card_ids.description: The cards to move, by id (from read_board)

items.description: A card id on the source board

draft.description: The draft key create_boards returned. Pass it on every call about that draft.
